entities.name: Guillermo Rodríguez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Guillermo Antonio Rodríguez Lara is an Ecuadorian former political and military leader who was the dictator of Ecuador from 1972 to 1976. He came to power after leading the 1972 military coup against President José María Velasco Ibarra. He characterised his government as "revolutionary and nationalistic."
